source_commit: card/224-grid-centred-again (implementation), branched from main at cc4430b with CARD-248 already merged at 1256982. Recorded against this card's own implementation on its worktree, after the grid went back to centred and began floating at 42% of the puzzle area's spare height, and before this file was written. A commit cannot carry its own hash, so the tree these digests were taken from is the implementation commit this file is added beside.
produced_by: proof_pages(book) on this card's own src/, for each CORPUS_TRIMS_CM trim stored as-is with the Book 1 margins stored as gutter_margin_cm='1.27', outside_margin_cm='1.27' — CON-018's amended outside margin (0.5 in), where CARD-204's recording stored the retired '0.95' (0.375 in).
why_a_new_baseline: CARD-224 reverses CARD-204's central decision: the puzzle drawing is CENTRED across the usable width again (FR-032's own clause, which CARD-204 had made false; the owner's artifact of 2026-10-14 restores it because CARD-223 moved the QR icon to the footer, so nothing reads the gutter-side strip the flush anchor freed), and vertically it FLOATS at 42% of CARD-222's puzzle-area spare height instead of sitting at the fixed top edge FR-032 asked for until the 2026-10-17 amendment (AC-190 retired, AC-366/AC-367 added). A proof page is the book's own sheet drawn through the same render_pages() call a real interior page uses, so both moves land on it: every drawing moves sideways by half its own spare and down by 0.42 of its page's spare. All nine portrait corpus trims therefore move, which 'moved_from_card223' records as measured rather than argued.
warning: Never regenerated to make a test pass. A proof page that stops matching this file is either a deliberate change — which earns its own successor, with its own note — or a regression.
moved_from_card223_note: All nine, measured trim by trim against CARD-223's recording before this file was written, not asserted from the change's intent. Nine of nine is the expected shape here: the placement change applies to every drawing on every sheet, so a trim that did NOT move would be the surprise — the opposite of CARD-223's own recording, where three pages moving and ten staying byte-identical was the evidence.
